thread:
tasha (docs): Heads up team: i opened a docs PR to reconcile the new invoke envelope with migration notes and guardrail examples. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4540. Need pairing on snippets and a short migration checklist.

ben (sdk): I can own TS/Python snippet updates. plan: show modern `client.invoke()` usage + a tiny backward-compat shim for `function_call` clients.

omar (runtime): FYI runtime now emits `invoke_v2` events for tool invocations. old `function_call` format is still supported under compatibility-mode but disabled by default on new Dedicated clusters. docs must reflect behavior.

nina (qa): i'll add a small test matrix for docs examples: compact envelope, expanded jsonschema envelope, and error paths (validation fail, missing outputs). i'll capture curl + sample responses.

sam (pm): partners demo next Wed — we need the migration snippet (curl + config toggle) and a clear note about latencies changing when going from compatibility-mode to v2.

tasha (docs): good call. proposed structure for the page: 1) quick example (v2) 2) how-to migrate from `function_call` 3) guardrails & validation patterns 4) SDK snippets (sync/async) 5) troubleshooting + links.

ben (sdk): working draft of TS snippet (will push to branch):
```ts
// robust access and fallback
const resp = await client.invoke('summarize', {text: input});
const primaryText = resp.outputs?.[0]?.text ?? null;
if (!primaryText) {
  // permissive parse: try older envelope shape
  const alt = resp.function_call?.args?.text ?? '';
}
```

omar (runtime): please don't suggest reading `function_call.args` directly for production. add a compatibility note and show `if (client.config.compatibility)` guard.

ben (sdk): ack, will show both patterns and a warning. also adding `validateAgainstSchema(schema, resp)` helper.

nina (qa): i ran quick smoke against the staging runtime: compact v2 envelope returns headers `x-invoke-latency` and `x-kv-cache` present, but when compatibility-mode is on the header `x-kv-cache` is `-` sometimes. will paste sample logs to PR.

tasha (docs): noted. we'll avoid claiming deterministic KV header semantics until that's stable. i'll change wording to "may expose cache hints in headers".

sam (pm): small ask: include a one-liner migration command for Dedicated: `redwoodctl config set invoke_compat true` (or whatever is accurate). docs should show the command and the expected behavior.

omar (runtime): correct CLI is `redwoodctl cluster set-invoke-compat --cluster <name> --enable`. include the exact flag.

ben (sdk): added a python snippet too, showing permissive parsing and schema validation with a short helper:
```py
resp = client.invoke('translate', {'text': 'hola'})
text = (resp.get('outputs') or [{}])[0].get('text') or resp.get('function_call', {}).get('args', {}).get('text')
```

tasha (docs): let's not model nested .get chains in the docs — prefer safe helper function to keep examples readable. i'll add a tiny `safeFirstOutputText(resp)` example.

nina (qa): QA note: we saw an edgecase where `outputs` is an empty array and `function_call` contains a `name` but empty `args` — recommend docs call this out under "unexpected empty outputs" and show resolution steps.

tasha (docs): adding a short bullet under troubleshooting: "empty outputs but tool signaled: check signed tool manifest & runtime logs" with an example log line.

ben (sdk): link fixes: some internal anchors changed. specifically `/docs/guides/tooling#invocation` moved to `/docs/guides/tooling#invocation-v2`. i'll update crosslinks in the PR.

sam (pm): and update the release notes blurb: "invoke v2: wire format change, compatibility toggle for Dedicated". i'll draft a tiny note.

docbot: Deploy preview up for PR 4540 — https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-4540 — preview valid 6 days.

omar (runtime): one more runtime note: on-prem customers using KMS with signed manifests will need to re-sign manifests when upgrading to invoke_v2 due to a canonicalization change. add migration step and contact support link.

tasha (docs): adding a short "on-prem KMS/signing" subsection with contact link to support and a sample re-sign command.

nina (qa): timeline: i can finish test artifacts by EOD today. please don't merge before QA ack.

ben (sdk): aiming to push updated snippets in 2hrs. will run `docs-ci check-links` and post results.

tasha (docs): thanks all. final checklist i'll add to PR description:
- update TS/PY snippets with safe-access helpers
- add migration curl and redwoodctl examples
- guardrail examples: reject-and-log + user-friendly error example
- mention KMS re-signing for on-prem
- fix internal anchors/links
- QA artifacts attached
- hold merge until QA green

sam (pm): sounds good. thanks for fast turnaround — partner demo saved.

ben (sdk): pushed snippet commit `docs: invoke v2 snippets + compat shim` -> https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4540/commits/def456

docbot: Reminder: PR 4540 requested reviewers: ben (sdk), omar (runtime), tasha (docs)

 tasha (docs): I'll merge after QA signoff and link-check passes. leaving this thread open for any late runtime gotchas.
